items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 13 August 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or southwest 2 to 4, occasionally variable 3 or less, then veering west or northwest 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Risk of coastal mist/fog patches developing in the afternoon and evening.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor in any mist and very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in places at times.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
